loading_observation: Supported retrieval evaluator uses PeAudioVideoModel.from_pretrained plus PeftModel.from_pretrained with is_trainable=False; it does not load training_state.pt. Safetensors-only loading is a feasible next path, not tested here.
dependencies: Upstream lower bounds include torch>=2.6, torchcodec>=0.7, transformers>=4.53, peft>=0.18, timm>=1.0. A new isolated pinned environment would be required; no installed environment was changed.
rationale: Retains temporally aligned feature sequences and scores their diagonal correspondence rather than only a single offset class. More directly relevant to local semantic/timing mismatch than the rejected global-offset ranking.
evidence_limits: The authors report mean sample-level Spearman correlation 0.1724 on 750 generated clips, with ten annotators and five generation families, none H3. This is a weak absolute correlation and a preprint result, not H3 validation or an expected improvement.

preflight_findings.observation: Invalid/failed video decoding falls back to black frames; empty audio becomes two seconds of zeros. This must be rejected as input failure in a local evaluation harness, not accepted as genuine media.
Duration failure silently becomes ten seconds. Local harness must preserve actual PTS/duration and explicit failure instead.

The special mask-length branch passes an N,T,D tensor directly to interpolate; in the synthetic padded case it resizes D rather than T. Not established to occur on an unpadded two-second clip. No upstream source edited.

Before any model inference, verify every required encoder/head and adapter key/shape, processor sampling, actual temporal feature clocks, padding masks and consistent window boundaries. Do not accept randomly initialized missing keys, arbitrary remote code or a silent source resampling shortcut.

next_action: Under the existing isolated evaluator authorization, freeze a bounded control protocol, audit the remaining processor/loading path and only then install verified safetensors and test. Include local timing and semantic controls as distinct dimensions. No automatic held-out admission or ranker fitting.
